obligations.detail: The operative LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts and the libvips LGPL-2.1 origin text are digest-bound into the generated notices; no relicensing is implied.
The upstream README licence table and the exact versions.json component versions are digest-bound into the generated notices.

All 29 libraries named by the tarball README (28 versioned components plus the libnsgif vendored inside libvips) have their exact upstream copyright/licence files for the exact pinned revisions tracked under Resources/ThirdPartyLicenses/sharp-libvips-1.3.2/, digest-bound in componentNotices and embedded into the generated notices. Rust crates linked through librsvg are covered only as an explicit approximation in Config/SharpLibvipsRustProvenance.json (159 crates.io crates and the licence texts their archives carry); which crates the historical build compiled and incorporated is not verified.

Config/SharpLibvipsSourceMaterials.json pins the 28 upstream source archives, 4 patches and build recipe of the exact 1.3.2 build commit, and Config/SharpLibvipsRustProvenance.json pins the 159 crates.io crates a simplified resolver identifies for librsvg-c (an approximation; the historical compile log was not retrieved), all by URL, size and SHA-256, acquirable into an ignored build directory by scripts/prepare-libvips-source-materials.mjs. None is shipped or offered with the binary, the compiled crate set is unverified and no rebuild was attempted: no corresponding-source offer exists yet.

libvips-cpp.8.18.3.dylib is dynamically loaded, but the app is intended to ship Developer ID signed with hardened runtime; whether a user can replace the library and re-run the app, and whether LGPL-3.0 section 4(d)/4(e) and GPL-3.0 section 6 Installation Information requirements apply, has not been assessed. Entitlements and signing policy are outside this record.
No formal legal clearance is claimed for redistributing this binary. The public external evidence gate thirdPartyBinaryLicenseMaterials remains the human review point.
